notes.title: Update Notes for September 28th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

another month, another little update for First Days of Atlantis. Here's what changed:

[olist]
[*] Improve terrain generation for large maps
[*] Rotate the camera by pressing the mouse wheel down and moving the mouse
[*] Added new color scheme
[*] Added new map template for generation
[/olist]

Hope you enjoy these improvements. Let me know if you have any ideas on how the game can be improved. 

For those of you coming from my TikTok, the secret letter is H.

Oh, also check out the new game I'm working on:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1712340/Jerichos_Rose

notes.title: Update Notes for August 14th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

here's another little update for First Days of Atlantis.

[olist]
[*] Added the option to automatically sort the cards in your hand.
[*] Added bigger maps for longer games. They are still pretty basic, so if you have any ideas for the bigger maps, let me know.
[*] You can rotate the camera with Q and E on your keyboard (this one was possible before, but I forgot to tell anyone...)
[/olist]

Also the Steam page for my second game "Jericho's Rose" just went live. It would mean a lot to me if you'd check it out and add it to your wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1712340/Jerichos_Rose/

notes.title: Update Notes for July 19 (Version 1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

here's the first little update for First Days of Atlantis. The following changes have been made:

[list]
[*] Added wider aspect ratios than 16:9 (If you have any trouble with them please let me know)
[*] Added the otter Oswald and his friends. They swim around the fishermen.
[*] Fixed bug with the display of leaderboards
[/list]

Hope you enjoy these changes! Have a nice week!
